classification_rules.covered_verified: Pair is one of the 85 already-fetched official monthly ZIPs (v1.10 80 + v1.11-b1 5). Those ZIPs were not refetched.
classification_rules.pending_check: Official monthly file exists (API listed or CDN HEAD 200); frozen+deltas already have at least the 8H-grid minimum row count for the NPZ bar span in that CST month, but the month has not been verified against the official ZIP.
classification_rules.confirmed_missing: Official monthly file exists, and frozen+deltas have 0 rows for that CST month, or fewer rows than the UTC 8H-grid (00/08/16Z) point count inside [npz_bar_first, npz_bar_last] ∩ the CST month.
classification_rules.official_unavailable: Official file not listed and not retrievable. sub_reason is one of: not_listed, 404, listing-suspension, boundary-insufficient.
classification_rules.boundary-insufficient: CST month is still open (2026-11 closes 2026-12-01 00:00 CST), so the official monthly ZIP is not published yet.
